projects.title: Ledgerline
projects.description: Double-entry bookkeeping for small studios and freelancers. Imports bank CSVs, suggests categorisations, and produces clean quarterly reports without a spreadsheet in sight.

projects.title: Fieldnote
projects.description: An offline-first field journal for naturalists. Records sightings with geotags and weather context, syncs opportunistically, and never loses an entry when the signal drops.

projects.title: Riverrun
projects.description: A tiny durable workflow engine on top of SQLite. Retries with backoff, a readable event log, and a single-file deployment story for teams that don't want Kafka.

projects.title: Hearth
projects.description: Self-hosted recipe scaling and meal planning. Paste any recipe URL and get clean, structured ingredients that re-scale without arithmetic crimes.

projects.title: Cadence
projects.description: A terminal dashboard for reading habits — sessions, pages, and streaks rendered in braille sparklines straight from a SQLite file.
